title: Poisoned state mutex expect() during unwind turns a test assertion into a fail-fast abort (federation_snapshots.rs:65)
outcome: A panic inside a test that holds or poisons the state mutex reports its own assertion failure instead of escalating to a second panic and a 0xc0000409 fail-fast abort that hides the remaining tests.
acceptance: A deterministic test shows that a panicking test holding the state lock reports its original assertion and the binary continues, with no 0xc0000409 abort.
The fix reuses an existing poison-tolerant pattern and changes no production lock semantics on the non-panicking path.
